a1-a.scene: Evening in a small West African savanna village of round mud-brick houses with thatched roofs, baobab and acacia trees. Inside a simple round room, two newborn babies with deep dark brown skin, wrapped in white and cream cloths, lie side by side on a woven mat. Kneeling beside them are only two smiling women in long dresses with large headscarves that fully cover their hair, ears and neck, one in plum and one in orange. A soft oil lamp glows.
